import importlib
import pandas as pd
import forecast_german_load as f
frame=f.load_data(f.Path('opsd_de_load.csv'))
ref=frame.index.min()
target=pd.date_range(f.TARGET_START_UTC, periods=f.TARGET_HOURS, freq='h')
actual=frame.loc[target, f.LOAD_COLUMN]
for lags in [(168,), (168,336), (24,168), (24,48,168), (24,48,168,336), (168,336,504), (24,168,336,504), (24,48,72,168,336)]:
    f.LAG_HOURS=lags
    best, rows=f.choose_alpha(frame, ref)
    model=f.fit_ridge(frame, f.TARGET_START_UTC, best, ref)
    fc=f.forecast_recursive(model, frame, target)
    m=f.metrics(actual, fc)
    print(lags, 'alpha', best, 'val mae', min(r['validation_mae_mw'] for r in rows), 'target', m.mae_mw, m.rmse_mw, m.mape_percent, m.bias_mw)
